metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Windhoek, Namibia (approximately -22.56°S, 17.08°E) - Time periods: February 2021 vs February average 2010-2020 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for 2021, but need Landsat for 2010-2020 (Sentinel-2 started in 2015) - Use Landsat 8 (2013-present) and Landsat 7 (1999-present) for historical comparison 2. Masking strategy: - Yes, mask clouds since we want valid NDVI comparisons - Use cloud mask functions for both Landsat and Sentinel-2 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid NDVI range is -1 to 1 - Check collection sizes for both periods - Check pixel counts after cloud masking - A valid zero/low NDVI is different from no data - Compare: if 2021 NDVI > historical average → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.08, -22.56]); const region = windhoek.buffer(10000); // 10km radius around Windhoek // 2. Data Acquisition for February 2021 (Sentinel-2) let feb2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-03-01') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size2021 = feb2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021 Images: ${size2021}`); if (size2021 === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-2 data for Feb 2021, trying Landsat 8...'); feb2021 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-03-01'); const sizeLandsat2021 = feb2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021 Landsat Images: ${sizeLandsat2021}`); if (sizeLandsat2021 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 3. Data Acquisition for 2010-2020 February Average (Landsat 7 & 8) const historical = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2013, 2020, 'year')) .merge( ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2010, 2020, 'year')) ); const sizeHist = historical.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical Feb Images (2010-2020): ${sizeHist}`); if (sizeHist === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Processing - NDVI Calculation Functions function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask) .normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } function maskLandsatClouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const nir = image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const red = image.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.updateMask(qaMask).updateMask(saturationMask) .addBands(nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI')) .select('NDVI'); } // Process 2021 data let ndvi2021; if (size2021 > 0) { ndvi2021 = feb2021.map(maskS2clouds).median(); } else { ndvi2021 = feb2021.map(maskLandsatClouds).median(); } // Process historical data const ndviHistorical = historical.map(maskLandsatClouds).median(); // 5. Calculate mean NDVI and pixel counts const stats2021 = ndvi2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const statsHist = ndviHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const count2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const meanHist = statsHist.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const countHist = statsHist.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021: NDVI=${mean2021?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${count2021}`); console.log(`Feb 2010-2020 Avg: NDVI=${meanHist?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${countHist}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (count2021 === 0 || countHist === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2021 == null || meanHist == null || mean2021 < -1 || mean2021 > 1 || meanHist < -1 || meanHist > 1) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (mean2021 > meanHist) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
